item.title: Ryan Reynolds and Blake Lively’s $500,000 gift helps train Indigenous water operators in Canada
item.description: Ryan Reynolds and Blake Lively's generous contribution to Water First has empowered Indigenous communities by enhancing their water management capabilities. After an intensive 15-month certification process, eight Indigenous trainees have successfully graduated, accumulating over 2,000 hours of combined practical and technical training. These graduates are set to embark on careers in water treatment, fostering self-sufficiency within their communities and showcasing a steadfast dedication to sustainable water management. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
